line.en: nfl in mexico city, american football: the 49ers host the vikings at the former azteca, kick-off around 19:20 local time.
line.de: nfl in mexiko-stadt, american football: die 49ers empfangen die vikings im früheren azteca, anpfiff gegen 19:20 ortszeit.
line.tr: mexico city'de nfl, amerikan futbolu: 49ers, vikings'i eski azteca'da ağırlıyor; başlama saati yerel saatle yaklaşık 19:20.

sparks.why: NFL Mexico City Game, Vikings at 49ers, Sun 22 Nov at Estadio Banorte; most sources give 7:20 p.m. local (DAZN, 49ers.com), though one listing differs.

title.en: free indigenous and afro-descendant film showcase.
title.de: kostenlose schau indigener und afrodeszendenter filme.
title.tr: ücretsiz yerli ve afro-kökenli film gösterimi.

line.en: four features and five shorts, free entry at the cineteca nacional chapultepec from 12:00. two talks with filmmakers; check each screening time first.
line.de: vier spielfilme und fünf kurzfilme, eintritt frei, in der cineteca nacional chapultepec ab 12:00. zwei gespräche mit filmschaffenden; zeiten pro film vorher prüfen.
line.tr: dört uzun metraj ve beş kısa film, giriş ücretsiz, cineteca nacional chapultepec'te 12:00'den itibaren. iki yönetmenle söyleşi var; film saatlerini önceden kontrol edin.

sparks.why: Muestra de Cine de los Pueblos Indígenas y Afrodescendientes 2026, free, from 12:00 on Sun 22 (IMCINE, Proceso, Maya Comunicación); per-film times not confirmed.
